title: Desired layer selection
summary: Store ordered immutable Extension references and enabled flags in LocalRegistry. Safe mode changes the derived selection, preserving desired layers and original bytes.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: attach

base.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

extension.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

operations.notes: No deadline. Resolves before persisting the selected profile; Resolver/Registry errors propagate in addition to listed direct refusals. Safe-mode profile retains desired references but selects Base-only. attach/detach are not retry-idempotent. This mutates local state only, not a running Worker.

output.description: Empty object if absent, otherwise layer profile schema.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

invariants.text: Disable/restore preserves ordered desired layers and Base identity; no source is rewritten.
